summary: Mutual NDA on Vandenberg paper with a residuals clause, an unworkable compelled-disclosure regime, narrowed carve-out evidence and a non-solicit longer than 12 months, otherwise close to the playbook.

findings.quote: "Disclosing Party" means the Party (or its Affiliate) that discloses or makes available Confidential Information to the Receiving Party under this Agreement.
findings.why: Disclosing and Receiving Party are defined so either Party can be either, and obligations apply to both.

findings.quote: which is disclosed, made available, or observed prior to, on, or after the Effective Date in connection with the Authorized Purpose.
findings.why: Covers confidential or proprietary information disclosed for the Purpose, plus derived Evaluation Material, with no marking requirement.

findings.quote: use and reproduce the Confidential Information solely to the extent strictly necessary to evaluate, negotiate, and advance the Authorized Purpose;
findings.why: Use is limited to the stated preliminary discussions on strategic collaboration, a purpose limitation close to preferred.
findings.fallback_cited: Purpose limited to a named project, product evaluation or pilot.

findings.quote: which the Receiving Party can establish by clear contemporaneous written records:
findings.why: All four carve-outs are present but the evidence standard is narrowed to clear contemporaneous written records, stricter than the acceptable 'written records' or 'reasonable evidence'.
findings.draft_redline: which the Receiving Party can establish by written records or other reasonable evidence:
findings.note_to_counterparty: We have kept the four exclusions but ask that the evidence standard be written records or reasonable evidence, so that it works equally for both of us.

findings.quote: "Representatives" means the directors, statutory managing directors, supervisory board members, officers, employees, professional legal counsel, independent statutory auditors, and retained management consultants of a Party or of any of its Affiliates.
findings.why: Representatives covers Affiliates, auditors and legal counsel but omits insurers and professional advisers other than legal counsel and consultants.
findings.draft_redline: "Representatives" means the directors, officers, employees, professional advisers, auditors and insurers of a Party or of any of its Affiliates.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Could we add insurers and professional advisers generally to the Representatives definition, as both of us will need to share with them on a need-to-know basis?

findings.quote: at its own sole cost and expense, exhaust all available legal and procedural remedies to challenge, narrow, resist, or obtain a protective order against such compelled production before making any disclosure of the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.
findings.why: Receiving Party must resist and challenge compelled disclosure at its own cost, which is a listed deviation.
findings.draft_redline: use reasonable endeavours, at the Disclosing Party's cost, to obtain confidential treatment of the information to be disclosed, and otherwise disclose only to the extent required.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are happy to give notice and cooperate, but ask that any steps to resist disclosure be at the Disclosing Party's cost.

findings.quote: The Receiving Party shall not disclose any portion of the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information pursuant to any legal, judicial, or regulatory demand unless and until all formal objections, applications for relief, and legal proceedings to resist disclosure have been definitively adjudicated and dismissed by a final, unappealable order of a court of competent jurisdiction.
findings.why: Bars disclosure until all challenges are exhausted by a final unappealable order, so there is no workable exception for disclosure required by law, regulator or stock exchange.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 4.2 and permit disclosure to the extent required by law, court, regulator or stock exchange.
findings.note_to_counterparty: A requirement to exhaust all appeals could put either of us in breach of the law, so we ask to replace it with a standard to-the-extent-required exception.

findings.quote: throughout the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly solicit, induce, recruit, engage, or hire any officer, senior consultant, software architect, or key employee of the other Party or its Affiliates
findings.why: Mutual non-solicit that also bars hiring, runs for the term plus 24 months (over 12 months) and has no general-advertising exception.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 5, or limit it to a mutual 12-month restriction on soliciting staff worked with in the discussions, excluding general advertising.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We would prefer no non-solicit; if one is needed, we can accept a mutual 12-month limit on solicitation with an exception for general advertising.

findings.why: Fourteen calendar days is about 10 Business Days, with officer certificate and a backup exception retaining confidentiality in 6.2.

findings.quote: the Receiving Party and its Representatives shall be free to use for any purpose the Residuals resulting from access to or work with the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information
findings.why: Residuals clause gives a right to use information retained in unaided memory for any purpose.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 2.4 and the definition of Residuals in 1.1.14.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are unable to accept a residuals clause, as it would permit use of retained information for any purpose; we have removed it.

findings.quote: shall remain the sole and exclusive property of the Disclosing Party or its respective licensors.
findings.why: Ownership stays with the Disclosing Party and clause 7.2 grants no licence.

findings.quote: The Disclosing Party makes no express or implied representations or warranties as to the accuracy, completeness, technical operability, or fitness for any particular purpose of any information disclosed hereunder.
findings.why: Mutual as-is disclaimer, with a fraud carve-out in 8.2.

findings.quote: continue in full force and effect for an additional period of three (3) years from the effective date of termination or expiration.
findings.why: Two-year term with 30 days' notice and three-year survival match the preferred position.

findings.quote: the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, specific performance, and other equitable remedies before any court of competent jurisdiction, without the necessity of proving actual damages or posting any bond or collateral security.
findings.why: Mutual 'entitled to seek' equitable relief with no bond is within the acceptable fallback.
findings.fallback_cited: 'Entitled to seek' rather than 'entitled to'; no requirement to post a bond.

findings.quote: the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction
findings.why: English law and exclusive English jurisdiction.

findings.quote: Neither Party may assign, transfer, novate, or encumber any of its rights or delegate any of its obligations under this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the other Party.
findings.why: Mutual no assignment without prior written consent.

findings.quote: strictly prohibit any copying, reverse compilation, decompilation, reverse engineering, or systematic extraction of structural or architectural principles
findings.why: Prohibits reverse engineering of software and technical materials.
